name: Hermes WebUI
author: nesquena
description: Hermes WebUI is a lightweight, dark-themed web interface for Hermes Agent. It provides near-complete parity with the CLI experience via a three-panel layout with session management, chat, and workspace file browsing. Use it in any browser, or pair it with the Hermes Agent Mobile iOS app by setting a password.

form_fields.label: Gateway URL
form_fields.hint: URL of your existing Hermes Agent gateway (e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8642)

form_fields.label: Password
form_fields.hint: Password for web UI access. Required when using Hermes Agent Mobile (iOS app).

form_fields.label: Default Model
form_fields.hint: Optional model override (e.g. claude-sonnet-4-6). Leave blank to use the agent's configured default.
